examples.text: The sugars in overripe fruit attract microscopic organisms known as yeasts. As the yeasts feed on the fruit sugars they produce a compound called ethanol— the type of alcohol in alcoholic beverages. This process is called fermentation.

source.text: A brief history of alcohol - Rod Phillips

relations.reason: 例句明确说明酵母分解糖会产生 ethanol，而这个过程叫 fermentation；两者是“产物—过程”的核心关系。
例句中 yeasts 是产生 ethanol 的微生物来源，学习 ethanol 时跳转到 yeasts 有助于理解其生物生成机制。
